name: Three-position disconnector
summary: A three-position disconnector selects between two paths and an intermediate position.
description: A three-position disconnector selects between two paths and an intermediate position. Switchgear schematics must define each position and any linked earth or isolation function explicitly.
readingNotes: The middle position must be labelled rather than assumed to be open or earthed.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: Three positions describe available states; they do not imply that every transition can occur under load.
